remark:
NOTE 1 : TOTAL AREA OF THE PROJECT AS PER APPROVED SITE PLAN IS 1258.88 SQ.YD. I.E., 1052.58 SQ.MTR WHICH IS ACTUAL AREA ON SITE LOCATION. JDA HAS APPROVED ARCHITECT'S MAP BASED ON THE AFOREMENTIONED CALCULATION, HOWEVER WHILE TYPING BUILDING PERMISSION LETTER JDA OFFICER HAS MADE A CLERICAL ERROR IN COMPUTING AREA OF THE PROJECT AS THEY HAVE MENTIONED THE AREA OF 1052.68 SQ.MTR THEREIN. THEREBY IT IS MENTIONED AS 1052.68 SQ.MTR IN BUILDING SANCTION PLAN. THE MAPS, THE AREA CALCULATIONS, THE BUILDING DIMENSIONS ARE BASED ON ACTUAL SITE LOCATION AREA I.E., 1052.58 SQ.MTR. HOWEVER FOR RERA FEES CALCULATION HIGHER AREA IS CONSIDERED I.E., 1052.68 S.Q. M.T.R. THUS, SUCH CALCULATION ERROR BEING BASED ON FORMULA ROUND OFF CAN BE IGONRED HEREWITH. KINDLY TAKE A NOTE.

NOTE 2: The Promoter has provisioned a club house, toilet and a guard room on the stilt floor of the building as mentioned under approved maps. This being facilities is not available for sale  and is for the use of the residents of the building.

Note 3: The parking details are as per the approved map and the parking facility is available in open area and stilt area. The vehicles which are fully parked under covered area are considered for stilt parking and rest vehicles are shown under open area parking. Kindly  take a note.
